visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a red sweater and blue jeans, kneels behind a white table covered with many 100 TWD bills. She smiles brightly, holding a yellow sticky hand toy and a red envelope with a rabbit illustration. The background is a brightly lit indoor living room with a brown leather sofa. (2) A young girl in a pink dress and white turtleneck takes the first turn, swinging a yellow sticky hand at the money on the table. A group of about six people stands behind the table, watching and reacting with laughter and gestures. The camera angle is eye-level, capturing the excitement of the group. (3) The scene cuts rapidly between different family members—the woman in red, another woman in a light blue hoodie, a man in a black vest, and a young boy—all taking turns attempting to 'grab' the bills with the sticky hands. Each person exhibits intense facial expressions, ranging from focused concentration to explosive joy or disappointment. (4) The camera pans and zooms to follow the sticky hand as it makes contact with the table surface, sometimes lifting a bill and other times missing. Yellow variety-show style captions appear frequently at the center and bottom of the frame to narrate the successes and failures. (5) In the final phase, the entire group of eight people, including children and adults, crowds together behind the table. They all hold up the money they have 'won' and wave at the camera, their faces filled with celebratory smiles. The lighting remains bright and warm throughout the scene.

Background laughter from several people is audible. (2) A sharp 'thud' or slap sound occurs as a toy hits the table, followed immediately by a 'ding' success sound effect and a burst of collective cheering and applause. (3) The sequence repeats with a series of rhythmic slaps against the table. Vocal reactions are dense, featuring excited shouts like 'Oh!' and 'Yay!' alongside humorous cartoon-style 'boing' or 'pop' sound effects when misses occur. (4) The primary female narrator continues to commentate with a fast, high-arousal speech rate, punctuated by frequent laughter from the surrounding group. The BGM remains constant, providing a joyful, festive foundation. (5) The video concludes with the entire group shouting 'Happy New Year' in unison, followed by a final musical flourish and fading laughter.
